notes_i18n.en: Candidate culvert: tertiary road crosses mapped OSM stream without a bridge tag. No surveyed dimensions.

methodology: Each bottleneck's segments are made unavailable from the analysis time; sector / facility reachability from safe bases, access-loss times (max–min path) and fastest travel times are compared with the baseline scenario graph. Score = newly isolated population/100 + Σ criticality of newly unreachable facilities/10 + mean travel-time increase (min). For a selected bottleneck the active plan is re-evaluated with it unavailable (task status, slack, travel time, detour roads). Network consequences only — no hydraulic capacity is modelled.
